datasets.title: Population by Province in 2010 in Solomon Islands
datasets.description: The population was compiled from available census reports and validated using other available datasets. For each country, population counts from the finest resolution was trended to 2010 using a country-specific annual growth rate assumptions. Underlying vector geometry comes from regional sources, primarily SPC. Primary Data Source(s): PopGIS, Solomon Islands National Statistics Office Secondary Data Source(s): SPC (GPS Points), DIGO Geographical Resolutions Available (with count): 1. Province (10) 2. Ward (183) 3. Enumeration Area (1,143) Additional Comments: 1. This population database is misaligned due to the source data provided in the SPC?s PopGIS data set. This misalignment is not linear and the largest measured misalignment in a significantly populated region is approximately 600 meters.
